0022600189.text: The Indiana Pacers (2-6, on a five-game losing streak) face the Denver Nuggets (3-3) in the NBA Mexico City Game at a neutral site in Mexico City, with Indiana 12th in the East and 4 games back in the Central after going 0-4 at home and 2-2 on the road. Denver, 10th in the West and 2 games back in the Northwest, has lost its most recent game and is missing DeMar DeRozan (back spasms), Julian Strawther (knee sprain) and Spencer Jones (hamstring). Indiana is without Tyrese Haliburton (hamstring strain), Kelly Oubre Jr. (calf bruise), Ben Sheppard (knee), Johnny Furphy (knee, surgery) and T.J. McConnell (hamstring strain), and the teams have not met yet in 2026-27 after Indiana lost the 2025-26 season series 0-2, most recently 135-120 in Indianapolis on December 3, 2025.
